reasoning: This is a word-processor UI chrome glyph for setting an object's text-wrapping mode to 'in line with text' (a square aligned with the baseline of a short line between two full lines). It represents a document formatting property rather than a recognizable real-world subject for to-do tasks, and is easily confused with generic layout or alignment icons.
